text:
𝗧𝗜𝗟𝗔𝗞 𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗜𝗡 𝗩𝗔𝗜𝗡! 🇮🇳

Tilak Varma 100 off 149, but India A lost to Pakistan A by 48 runs.
He and Shahbaz added 112 from 129/6.

Beat UAE today = semi-final. 👇
#IndiaA #RisingStars

facebook.caption:
𝗧𝗜𝗟𝗔𝗞 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗞, 𝗣𝗔𝗥 𝗛𝗔𝗔𝗥! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Tilak Varma ne 149 gend mein 100 banaye
👉 India A 129/6 pe the, phir Shahbaz ke saath 112 ki partnership
👉 Pakistan A ne 313 banaye, India A 265 pe all out - 48 run se haar
👉 Aaj UAE ko haraya to semi-final pakka!

Kya India A aaj jeet kar semi-final mein jayegi? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #IndiaA #AsiaCupRisingStars
